scope: Verified against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text. Colorant selection and compositing are normative; native CMYK display simulation and alternate-based spot ink equivalents are documented device policy.

requirements.rule: OP updates op only when op is absent in the same dictionary; fill and stroke flags, OPM and save/restore are independent.
requirements.gaps: Display approximation uses CMYK ink equivalents with saturation; physical ink spectra and output-intent ICC destination transforms are not modeled. Spot plates have a per-page budget of 32. Transfer selection remains explicitly unsupported.

requirements.rule: Compatible overprinting preserves unspecified components. OPM 1 selects nonzero direct DeviceCMYK tints before quantization, excluding sampled images and shadings. Other blend modes apply to the implicit non-isolated group result.
requirements.gaps: Display approximation uses CMYK ink equivalents with saturation; physical ink spectra and output-intent ICC destination transforms are not modeled. Spot plates have a per-page budget of 32. Transfer selection remains explicitly unsupported.

requirements.rule: Named spot plates retain identity across groups. OP controls unspecified plates; named zero tints still paint. Non-white-preserving or non-separable blend modes substitute Normal on spot plates.
requirements.gaps: Display approximation uses CMYK ink equivalents with saturation; physical ink spectra and output-intent ICC destination transforms are not modeled. Spot plates have a per-page budget of 32. Transfer selection remains explicitly unsupported.

requirements.rule: Elementary overprinting occurs within group colorants. Completed groups paint every component, ignoring invocation overprint flags; isolated groups begin without backdrop ink.
